old: Instability labels. Each zone in each trial was labelled stable or unstable. Because the model receives spectral features, a label defined only from the same spectra would make high accuracy partly circular. Labels were therefore assigned from two sources: (i) the chatter indicator of Equation (7) computed on [the channel not used as model input / the full-duration record, using a threshold set before model training], and (ii) visual inspection of the machined surface under [×10] magnification for chatter marks in the corresponding zone. A zone was labelled unstable when [rule, e.g., both criteria agree; disagreements resolved by a second annotator blind to the spectra]. Inter-annotator agreement was [Cohen’s κ = X.XX]. [Report the resulting class balance.]
new: Each zone in each trial was labelled stable or unstable. Because the model receives spectral features, a label defined from the same short-window spectra would make high accuracy partly circular. Labels were therefore computed from the full-duration force record of each zone (≈3.75 s, Welch PSD with 32768 points, ≈0.76 Hz resolution, against ≈24 Hz in the 100 ms model windows) with a rule fixed before model training: a zone is unstable when the dominant peak of the summed three-axis force PSD in the 2.5–5.5 kHz band does not lie within ±2 Hz of a spindle-rotation harmonic and rises at least 20 dB above the band median. Visual inspection of the machined surface was not available for this dataset (no per-zone surface images in the archive), so the labels rest on this single criterion and inter-annotator agreement does not apply. The rule labelled 10 of 96 zones unstable (10.4%): 10/60 for waam, 0/36 for wrought.

new: This work proposed a spatio-temporal graph formulation for monitoring the milling of WAAM Al 5356 thin walls, in which cutting zones are nodes, tool-path order and heat diffusion define the edges, and force, vibration and thermal measurements form the node features. On 16 trials with force and acceleration input, the ST-GAT detected instability with an AUC of 0.47 (0.22–0.74) against 0.63 (0.20–0.89) for a non-graph multimodal baseline, and recognised the material-level Ra with an RMSE of 0.098 µm. Thermal information and zone-level Ra could not be evaluated with the available records, so RQ3 remains open.
